name: Hidden Acres Fruit Farm
description: Hidden Acres Fruit Farm grows Blueberries, Pears, Persimmons, Figs, and Grapes in Eufaula, AL. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
